CustomField.description: API name of the conversion status picklist on the Form Submission to stamp for this step, for example FlowToolKit__Conversion_Status_Contact_1__c. Set it here and the Log Conversion Event action reads it from the event, so the flow does not need a formula to derive it from Type. Leave blank to keep today's behaviour: the flow passes the field name to the action itself.
CustomField.label: Conversion Status Field Api Name
